<thought>Using the mapped reaction provided for template 149040, the two reactants (precursors) are identified. By stripping the atom‑mapping annotations from the SMILES strings we obtain the plain SMILES for each precursor:
1. O=S(=O)(O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C(F)(F)F
2. CCOC(=O)CC1CC(O)C(C)C(=C(C)C(=O)OCH3)O1
These two SMILES form the only possible precursor combination for the given template, so the required output is a list containing this single combination.</thought>
<final_answer>[["O=S(=O)(O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C(F)(F)F", "CCOC(=O)CC1CC(O)C(C)C(=C(C)C(=O)OCH3)O1"]]</final_answer>
